reviews.name: First Advantage
reviews.note: Founded 2003 and region/language menu verified. HQ and parent not stated on About Us or home page. API page (/api/) describes docs and a sandbox but states no access rule; /developers/ returned 404. api_status left unknown. Partner page (/partners/) states a partner program ('Partner with First Advantage so we can shape the future of work together.'); partner_program was not in the requested fields so it is not recorded in boards. Primary language inferred as English from the default English menu entry; not separately quoted.

reviews.name: Russell Reynolds Associates
reviews.note: Founded 1969: the year appears as the timeline heading above the quoted sentence, so the quote does not itself contain the year; check the history page. Languages from the language menu: English, Chinese, Japanese. HQ not labelled; the only office block is 'OUR NEW YORK OFFICE' at 277 Park Avenue, New York, NY 10172, USA, so hq_country not recorded. Partnerships page describes collaborations (Hogan, UN Global Compact, 30% Club) but no partner program or sign-up.

reviews.name: Novoresume
reviews.note: Founded 2014 and language menu verified. Business model: the core builder is free and paid Pro is a one-time pass for job seekers; no employer pricing is shown, so this is a job seeker model, not how employers pay. Homepage FAQ calls it 'a Danish company' (not recorded, hq not requested). Media kit page had no pricing.

reviews.name: Revelio Labs
reviews.note: Business model from pricing page: Terminal starts at $1,250 per month, with an annual commitment (annual commitment is from the FAQ and not separately quoted), plus quote-based enterprise data and API plans and a free Terminal trial. Company page and home page state no founding year, HQ or parent; footer shows only the copyright line.

reviews.name: Kelly Services
reviews.note: Founded 1946 verified from Our story page. Our story page says 'Headquartered in Troy, Michigan' but states no country, so hq_country is not recorded. About Kelly page gives no HQ. Investor relations page returned 403 on fetch and browser; it was not bypassed.

reviews.name: Pinpoint
reviews.note: Request-pricing page says pricing is a custom quote after a call ('provide you with an accurate price'); no payment model (subscription, per post, free) is stated. /pricing returned 404. News page has no HQ, founding or parent facts.

reviews.name: Harver
reviews.note: Founded 2015 verified from About Us. Only founded was requested; HQ and parent were checked on the newsroom and home pages and are not stated. 'Outmatch is now part of Harver' describes an acquisition, not a parent.

blocked.name: Kelly Services
blocked.note: 403 Access Denied on fetch and on one browse.js run; not retried or bypassed.
